service.en: Stop a circular on a sponsored person
service.ar: إيقاف التعميم على مكفول في القائمة الإدارية
service.ur: زیر کفالت شخص پر سرکلر روکنا

about: Remove a sponsored person from ICP's administrative list.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Stop a circular on a sponsored person. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Complete any changes ICP asks for if the application is returned
documents: Letter from the body that submitted the circular
fees: Individual file: application 100 AED, smart service fee 100 AED and lifting the ban 1,000 AED
Company file: application 100 AED, smart service fee 100 AED and lifting the ban 2,000 AED
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
